unit.why: A single narrative in which the Besht frees a toll-collector's house from a spirit sent by sorcery, using amulets and his own presence.

stories.start_quote: פ"א בא מוכסין אחד מעיר קטנה
stories.end_quote: לא הייתי בביתי והרג ב׳ שרצים
stories.summary_en: A toll collector whose belongings were halved each night by sorcery fetches the Besht. The Besht has a scribe write protective amulets, travels to the house and drives out the spirit, which appears to him as a huge Cossack that shrinks and vanishes. Afterwards the non-Jewish miller's wife comes weeping to report that her husband came home in a rage and killed two creatures.
